items: `clientLoader` runs route data work in the browser. Return the values that the route component will read.

blocks.text: The fallback gives the reader a clear waiting message while that route prepares its initial client data.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: The fallback is part of a route with a clientLoader. It is not a substitute for a component that renders the finished data.
